name: chapterdesk
description: Offline-first AI-assisted story writing. An Electron shell with its own local API server and an Angular SPA.

scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:server && concurrently -k "ng serve" "wait-on http://localhost:4200 && electron ."
scripts.electron:build: npm run build:server && npm run build && electron-builder
scripts.electron:build:dir: npm run build:server && npm run build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.electron:build:appx: npm run build:server && npm run build && electron-builder --win appx
scripts.docker:prod: docker build -t chapterdesk . && docker run --env-file .env --rm -p 8080:8080 chapterdesk
scripts.docker:dev: docker build -f Dockerfile.dev -t chapterdesk-dev . && docker run -v ./chapterdesk-api-server/data:/app/data -e CHAPTERDESK_DOCKER=1 -e CHAPTERDESK_RUNTIME=docker-dev -e CHAPTERDESK_STORAGE=chats-idb --env-file .env --rm --name chapterdesk-dev -p 8080:8080 -p 9229:9229 chapterdesk-dev
scripts.docker:drun: docker run -v ./chapterdesk-api-server/data:/app/data -v /dist/chat/browser:/app/public:ro -e CHAPTERDESK_DOCKER=1 -e CHAPTERDESK_RUNTIME=docker-dev -e CHAPTERDESK_STORAGE=chats-idb --env-file .env --rm --name chapterdesk-dev -p 8080:8080 -p 9229:9229 chapterdesk-dev
scripts.docker:local: docker run -v ./chapterdesk-api-server/data:/app/data -v /dist/chat/browser:/app/public:ro -e CHAPTERDESK_DOCKER=1 -e CHAPTERDESK_RUNTIME=docker-dev -e CHAPTERDESK_STORAGE=sqlite-all --env-file .env --rm --name chapterdesk-dev -p 8080:8080 -p 9229:9229 chapterdesk-dev
scripts.e2e:build: npm run build:server && npx ng build && docker compose -f docker-compose.e2e.yml build
